snippet.title: Gunclone Arena (Steam Announce Trailer)
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4265740/Gunclone_Arena/

Gunclone Arena is a top-down looter-shooter roguelite. Fight as a super-clone that can wield 6 weapons, a Beam and Shield in a dystopian TV show! Loot thousands of weapon variants with ricochet, detonate, shock, pierce and more. Stack build-changing Mods. Notice: Escape is grounds for perma-recycle.

You are a disposable super clone, the star of a brutal televised arena show, and you live as long as you stay profitable to the producer. Reach a lifetime value of 1 million credits and you can buy your birth certificate to become a real human.

Each run is about making quick decisions under pressure, surviving the arena, and planning your build between fights. Weapons do more than deal damage. They change how fights play out. Shots bounce off walls, pass through enemies, trigger chain reactions, and reward good positioning. Movement and awareness matter just as much as your gear

 Weapons and loadouts are looted inside the arena, but all swapping and build decisions happen backstage in the shop. What you bring back between rounds matters, and bad choices can lock you into a risky run. Move through enemy swarms while your weapons auto-aim, or switch instantly to manual aim when you want full control. Dash to dodge incoming attacks or block bullets with your Shield.

You decide how hands-on each fight becomes. Progression is harsh by design. Gold is everything, dying ends the run, and staying longer in the arena always comes with risk. Leave early and secure your gains, or push further for higher rewards as the arena ramps up and the crowd goes mad. The story unfolds naturally during runs. Sponsor messages, system glitches, and strange interruptions slowly reveal that the arena is hiding something. Built for short, repeatable runs with endless scaling, Gunclone Arena rewards experimentation, risk taking, learning enemy patterns, and pushing builds as far as they can go.
